识别分两轮：第一轮比方向串（拐弯的次序，例如 ↗←↓→），方向和拐弯次序完全对上: Recognition runs in two rounds. Round one compares direction strings (the order of turns, e.g. ↗←↓→): an exact match wins straight away. If no string matches, round two compares the shape of the whole stroke — both paths are normalized into a 1000×1000 box (so size and screen position do not matter) and resampled to 64 evenly spaced points that are averaged one by one; a closed loop also gets its start point rotated and is tried once in reverse. That is why the same loop still matches when you start elsewhere on it, draw it bigger or smaller, or go counter-clockwise instead.
识别引擎就是 WGestures 2 那一套（v5.11 起启用，v5.13 起: The engine is the WGestures 2 one (enabled from v5.11, the only engine since v5.13 - no switch, no fallback path): a stroke is compressed into a curve of cumulative arc length s against direction and two curves are compared by the coupled distance of the squared angle change over arc length - drawing fast or slow, big or small, or starting a few pixels off changes nothing (measured 0.010-0.017 for the same shape and above 0.071 for different ones, with the threshold at 0.05). Every gesture with a stroke goes through it; gestures with no stroke at all (half-imported, not yet saved) get a polyline synthesised from their direction string and enter the same engine at the same threshold.
识别引擎用的是 WGestures 2 那一套（v5.11 起默认）：把一笔压成: The recognition engine is the one from WGestures 2 (default since v5.11): a stroke is reduced to a curve of cumulative arc length s against direction angle theta, and two curves are compared by their coupled integral of (d-theta)^2 ds, so drawing fast or slow, large or small, or starting a few pixels off does not change the result (measured: the same shape lands at 0.010-0.017, a different shape scores 0.071 and up, and the threshold is 0.05). Every gesture that has a recorded path goes through this channel; only old gestures that carry a direction string but no path (imported configs without point data) fall back to string comparison.
